t: 一场强烈的地震袭击了西西里岛的爱奥尼亚海岸,造成了数以万计的伤亡,特别是在卡塔尼亚.
te: A strong earthquake strikes the Ionian coast of Sicily, causing tens of thousands of injuries and deaths, especially in…
dz: 一场强烈的地震袭击了西西里岛的爱奥尼亚海岸,造成了数以万计的伤亡,特别是在卡塔尼亚.
de: A strong earthquake strikes the Ionian coast of Sicily, causing tens of thousands of injuries and deaths, especially in Catania.

t: 萨拉丁成为了埃及的埃米尔.
te: Saladin becomes the emir of Egypt.
dz: 萨拉丁成为了埃及的埃米尔.
de: Saladin becomes the emir of Egypt.

t: 诺曼雇佣兵在莱因斯特的班诺湾登陆,标志着诺曼人入侵爱尔兰的开始.
te: Norman mercenaries land at Bannow Bay in Leinster, marking the beginning of the Norman invasion of Ireland.
dz: 诺曼雇佣兵在莱因斯特的班诺湾登陆,标志着诺曼人入侵爱尔兰的开始.
de: Norman mercenaries land at Bannow Bay in Leinster, marking the beginning of the Norman invasion of Ireland.

t: 由法蒂米德军队的非洲黑人部队与多位埃及埃米尔和平民一起起兵,对抗萨拉丁.
te: Uprising by the black African forces of the Fatimid army, along with a number of Egyptian emirs and commoners, against …
dz: 黑军之战:由法蒂米德军队的非洲黑人部队与多位埃及埃米尔和平民一起起兵,对抗萨拉丁.
de: Battle of the Blacks: Uprising by the black African forces of the Fatimid army, along with a number of Egyptian emirs and commoners, against Saladin.
